SEARCH
Package hkust.marketplace.service

Class BrowseQuery

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.service.BrowseQuery
public class BrowseQuery extends Object
Search, filter and sort settings for Browse Marketplace (Task 1.3). Unset fields (null or blank) are ignored. Prices are kept as typed text so the service can report invalid input.
